content.text: The triage queue UI sorts tickets by last updated time instead of first response SLA remaining, so newest activity floats above breaches.
Agents miss SLA risk tickets that have not been touched recently because the default sort no longer matches the SLA board contract.
Restore first response SLA as the default sort, keep last updated as an optional column sort, and add a regression test for the default ordering.
